Here is what that means, and what to do about it. Elin Nyström 22 September 2026 , 1 min read, in running Most people with sore knees tell us the same thing: walking on the flat is fine, but stairs, hills and getting up from a low sofa hurt. That pattern is a clue, and a reassuring one. What stairs ask of the knee When you walk on the flat, the kneecap glides with very little pressure behind it.
